about.description: Frontend Developer. Specialist in React, Next.js and TypeScript. Mendoza (remote).

jobs.role: Frontend Team Lead · Architecture · Clean Code

RIU Hotels Website.name: RIU Hotels & Resorts — Official Website
RIU Hotels Website.description: Mindata is a digital services consultancy with an agile approach and distributed teams. As a senior frontend developer in Angular, I work on the official RIU Hotels & Resorts website (riu.com/es): a high-traffic, multilingual site for a global hotel chain, with a focus on code quality, frontend architecture, and user experience at scale.

YClick.name: YClick (YPF)
YClick.description: Ambitious YPF project. Frontend Team Leader. Responsibilities: implementing solutions, sprint planning, task distribution, client communication, estimations. Led the project re-engineering.

CGI Capital Landing.name: CGI Capital Landing
CGI Capital Landing.description: Corporate landing with 95+ Lighthouse score. Full i18n (es/en) with middleware-based locale detection. Form validation with Zod + React Hook Form.

CGI Capital Platform.name: CGI Capital — Investment Platform
CGI Capital Platform.description: Internal web platform for investment portfolio management. Multi-comitente account selector, real-time portfolio breakdown by asset type, paginated transaction history, multi-currency support (MEP, USD, ARS), and downloadable investment/movement reports.

Midas Filters Commerce.name: Filters eCommerce Catalog
Midas Filters Commerce.description: I led from scratch the reengineering of an automotive filters/spare-parts eCommerce, defining frontend architecture, engineering standards, and delivery roadmap. We implemented robust auth, access control, catalog, stock control, cart and checkout flow, with a strong focus on scalability, maintainability, and code quality.

EDEMSA Contratistas.name: EDEMSA Contractors — Cross-cutting Feature
EDEMSA Contratistas.description: I was responsible for building a cross-cutting feature for EDEMSA's contractor platform, impacting multiple business modules with a strong focus on complex forms. I implemented advanced business validations, role-based flows, multi-endpoint backend integration, and file handling, ensuring functional consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the application.

Mobile App.name: Mobile App
Mobile App.description: Cross-platform mobile application with monorepo architecture.

UP App.name: UP App — Kids Content Platform
UP App.description: I helped build from scratch a cross-platform mobile app inspired by TikTok, focused on curated content for kids. We built it on a solid Expo + React Native foundation, integrating video feed experiences, multi-profile onboarding, authentication, local persistence, i18n, and observability tooling. The product reached an advanced stage and received very positive feedback during an audit conducted by former Meta engineers.

Core DAO Ecosystem.name: Core DAO — Web Ecosystem
Core DAO Ecosystem.description: Multifaceted project across Core DAO's web ecosystem (Bitcoin DeFi blockchain). I redesigned the coredao.org homepage as a scroll storytelling experience: full-viewport sections, GSAP + Lenis + ScrollTrigger animations, Spline 3D hero, and live on-chain metrics. I also worked on stake.coredao.org (landing + staking dApp), bridge.coredao.org (cross-chain bridge), and other organization properties, maintaining visual and animation consistency across repos.

Agripay Back Office.name: Agripay — Back Office
Agripay Back Office.description: Agripay is a Pampas-born fintech with 30+ years of agro experience: they created the world's first non-monetary wallet to turn grains into transactional currency. I joined the Angular frontend team, making technical decisions and setting up E2E testing with Cypress from scratch. We built the web back office with functional parity to the mobile app, digitizing the agro payment circuit alongside mobile and backend teams. agripay.ar is a company reference; the landing page was outside my scope.
